affected_boundaries: native thread creation to durable review dispatch

observed_behavior: A newly created empty native reviewer cannot resume after disconnect.
expected_behavior: Canonical reviewer creation starts its actual review before closing the connection and retains the exact reviewer and turn.
causal_mechanism: thread/start yields an identity before its first turn has persisted a resumable rollout.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Creation is treated as durable dispatch before any actual turn.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A later connection cannot resume the empty actor despite its recorded identity.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Create and dispatch the actual review on one connection, journaling original identity and dispatch before execution.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Connect existing request and dispatch operations, reuse recorded reviewerThreadId for rework, collect original turns on retry, and preserve explicit loss replacement.

applicability_conditions: Native session persistence begins at the first actual turn.
known_non_matches: An already dispatched retained reviewer resumes through its recorded thread ID.
confirmation_evidence: The controlled native protocol rejects premature resume; canonical start-review executes review as turn-1 and retains its attached dispatch on retry.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: canonical reviewer creation starts the real review before resume and retains exact dispatch on retry
